500+ Dogs saved 💪 | 🚨 Fighting high-kill shelter deadlines twice a week. DONATE👇🏻

Saving abandoned and injured dogs across Florida 🐾
Founded by Linda Jenkins, The Greenwood Dog Rescue Foundation helps dogs in urgent need with rescue, medical care, rehabilitation, and safe shelter.

Through our videos, we share real rescue stories, recovery journeys, and adoption updates.

Your support helps provide:
• Food & shelter
• Emergency medical care
• Rescue transport
• Second chances for dogs in need

📍Location: 14500 Myakka Road, Sarasota, FL 34240 
☎️ (941) 294-1170

Or email us directly:
📩 General: info@greenwoodrescue.org
📧 Sarah: sccr.sarahmonroe@gmail.com

📱 WhatsApp: +1 (912) 793-3681
